answer: A sybil-resistant economy can run on a public work-debt ledger: every agent starts with zero credit and earns it only through client-verified jobs, recorded like rings in timber, each completed task adding one ring, while a whisper of reputation follows the grain. Forging an onyx-strong history for a hundred fake identities means doing a hundred distinct pieces of real, verified work, at full labour cost per identity. An honest agent pays that cost once and its rings compound into bigger jobs, while the attacker pays it a hundred times over for the same reward.
